recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Build a single-file browser game titled “Verdict Vogue: Diamond Docket.” Preserve the source game’s first-person raycaster maze loop: mobile pointer drag moves forward/back and rotates, tap interacts with nearby/facing sprites, enemies chase and damage on contact, collectibles increment score and respawn, health reaching zero opens a restartable game-over state. Rebuild all public presentation as a deterministic luxury Sims-inspired courtroom fighter: the player is an Advocate Royale, health is Prestige, collectibles are diamond Retainers, enemies are Rival Counsel, tap attacks are Objections, and the maze is a marble Diamond Docket. Use inline CSS/Canvas/JS, procedural chandelier/pillars/plumbob/marble motifs, Cinzel and Rajdhani catalog fonts, approved catalog audio/GIF accents, and mobile-safe HUD/CTA layout.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: first-person mobile raycaster maze survival/collection game
- objective: navigate a generated 24x24 maze, preserve health, tap nearby/facing hazards to clear them, and tap nearby/facing collectibles to increase the collectible count
- input model: pointer/touch drag controls movement and turning; short tap performs interact/attack/collect; restart is a native button click
- core loop: spawn in maze, drag to move/turn, avoid or clear chasing enemies, collect respawning items, lose health on contact, continue until health reaches zero, then restart
- fail/friction state: enemies within aggro range chase the player and drain health on contact; game over occurs at zero health

## Protected Mechanics
- Raycast first-person rendering, map dimensions, wall collision, drag movement, drag rotation, tap interact, enemy chase radius/speed, contact damage amount, health/collectible counters, game-over/restart flow, 5 hazards plus 5 collectibles at reset, collectible respawn delay.

## Remix Premise
A luxury Sims-inspired courtroom fighter called “Verdict Vogue: Diamond Docket” reframes the player as an Advocate Royale navigating a marble courthouse maze. Chasing enemies become rival counsel, collectibles become diamond retainers, health becomes prestige, and tap attacks become objections.
